decision: Does shared design conditioning justify paid scaling beyond one free T4 experiment?

prediction_before_fit.expected_ewart: Endpoint-dependent; six-drug confidence intervals may cross zero

fixed_model.loss: dimensionless residual weighted L1; equal screen/chemical mass
fixed_model.train_designs: all C(L,3), every observed target output retained

evaluation.screen_out: 4 fits. Entire target screen withheld, plus all its chemical identities excluded from source screens. Evaluate original fold 1 of NFA/acute/Harrill and all Ewart drugs.
evaluation.within_screen: Original fold 1 for three larger screens with a single shared model; six Ewart leave-one-drug-out shared models. Exclude test chemical identity globally.
evaluation.metrics: Original per-design curve MAE, five seeded original contexts; then average designs and drugs. Ewart author units separately by endpoint.
evaluation.comparator: Frozen target-informed within-screen AnchorBoost per-drug errors, on exact same samples/designs; recompute only if original baseline training contains a test alias. This reference is stronger in data access than screen-out neural.
evaluation.published_neural_process: Frozen original per-chemical NFA errors only, same k=3 designs/metric. Other screens unavailable, never imputed.
evaluation.bootstrap: 4000 paired resamples of chemical identity, seed0; 95% reported; familywise 6 comparison interval for rental decision
evaluation.rental_trigger: At least one screen-out difference vs AnchorBoost has familywise upper bound <0 and >=12 independent chemical identities; then query current Vast.ai cards/prices/hours only. Point estimate wins with CI crossing zero give rental recommendation $0.

scaling.fitted: One dimensionless residual scale fitted on training rows only, separately per fit; saved in checkpoint.
scaling.observed_context_forward: Per-endpoint max absolute observed response, with exactly-zero context set to 1, is an algebraic input transform only; full test curves never enter it.
scaling.upstream_representation: Reuse immutable existing benchmark target matrices and original preparation. NFA published control transform, acute/Harrill pooled vehicle normalization and acute pooled outlier filtering are inherited benchmark definitions. Claims concern training isolation conditional on these matrices, not an upstream raw-data inductive audit.
scaling.mixed_units: Raw endpoints never share an unscaled loss or pooled Ewart MAE.

resource.local: minimum probe only, <4GB per process and <5min
resource.remote: new private slug, free T4, one device used, no paid purchase
resource.stop: All four screens both frozen evaluations complete or real platform/data error. No search/retraining based on test error.
